summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Shared player, NPC, loot, combat and presentation systems support those levels; Level 10's M.E.G. Outpost Bountiful includes a lakeside fishing spot, while Level 11's modeled city has a canal and skiff. Place-specific grades finish through a common 2006 compact-camera look.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored fixtures, shifting walls and hunters, with generated Manila sanctuary, M.E.G. waypoint, lore props and noclip seam.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus Level 2.1 simulated rooms, zones, agents and set pieces.
places/level3, places/gamma (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators and lifts; Gamma includes Marlo the smith.
places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; office structure/residents and hotel encounters, including Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level6, places/level61 (3D) - Lights Out and Snackrooms; Level 6.1 food-court shops, service, vending and Camp Amber connect onward to Level 11.

places/level7 (3D) - ocean, Seawatch, Fort Surrender and house/room spaces; fishing can cast to coastal or deep water, and places/debug is a separate test atmosphere while places/spamton is a basement showroom/boss arena.

places/level10 (3D, Bumper Crop) - heightmapped farm and M.E.G. Outpost Bountiful: farmhouse, barn, fields, well, oven, wheat and quest NPCs; lake dock/tackle box, lake-deep exit to Level 7, and roads to Level 11; wheat decoration fades out beyond 120 m over stubble ground.

places/level11 (3D, The Infinite City) - generated city districts, subway, Sedco Spotlight, canal promenade/bridges and skiff, Thrift Mode, skydeck elevator, apartment and quest locations; includes strip mall with parapet roof and drains.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares player actions, camera, player template and HUD, routing, and an eight-player cap; Backspace opens the main menu.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion/player precede swim, interactions and gameplay handlers, then spamton-fight, critter, main-menu and view3.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; scripts/view3.js toggles player.state.tp.
places/<place>/config.yaml + sim.js + cells - place setup and placements; sims build local layouts and tick local behavior, generally sleeping when empty.
sim.js - world cadence and onOutOfBounds referee; players return true for normal respawn, creatures with state.home return home, others are destroyed for manager respawn.
places/level10/sim.js - lays terrain-relative Bumper Crop scenery, outpost NPCs/props, wheat, lake dock and tackle cache, exits and ambience.
places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js - Level 11 city, street and underground assembler; sim builds city districts and local shop/apartment placements.
places/spamton/sim.js + scripts/spamton-boss.js - dedicated arena entry; sim lays basement and lights and manages boss presence; boss runs encounter and scripts/ui.js mounts arena HUD.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait and heading for player and M.E.G. NPC chains; caches measured paces by model/scale; scripts/lib/body3.js also supplies weapon, rowing and fishing-cast animations.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js through level7.js + data - per-level grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by simulations, geometry, labels and creature navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.

scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/clothes/faces data - seeded coats, face traits and expressions plus rendered heads/bodies/garments; mask children are attached from garment rows.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing and container helpers; player inventory handling accepts fishing catch tokens and fish meat.
scripts/lib/combat.js + scripts/lib/data/combat.yml + scripts/lib/ballistics.js - shared hit/armor and firearm accuracy/projectile rules used by player and NPC combat.

scripts/lib/condition.js + condition.yml, difficulty.yml and scripts/lib/stats.js - weapon/armor condition, balance multipliers and derived handling/carry values used by player, clothes, loot UI and NPC behavior.

scripts/lib/nav.js + builtin/nav - shared NPC path search budget/cache and body radius; scripts/lib/footsteps.js + footsteps.yml choose surface clips; scripts/lib/photo2006.js supplies photoBase/photoFinish to level look scripts for a common camera finish.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, L11_FAR, l11Lean, tick; places/spamton/sim.js - cadence, tick.

places/level10/sim.js and places/level184/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/terrain10.js and terrain184.js - heightAt, materialAt; scripts/barn10.js, farmhouse10.js, props10.js and props11.js - geometry/collider builders.

scripts/level10-use.js - ears.press for farm props; scripts/lib/level10-quests.js - QUESTS10, setWheatStep, setWatcherStep, setCellarStep, finishQuest, handleDialogueQuest10; scripts/worm10-geo.js supplies worm-clump geometry.

scripts/lib/fishing.js - checkFishableWater, startFishing, handleFishingClick, onFishNibble, onFishBite, getFishingLoot, finishFishingCatch, cancelFishing; scripts/bobber.js - onSpawn, updateSchedule, update, cleanup.

scripts/player.js - fishNibble, fishBite, fishAutoCatch, fishCatch timer handlers; scripts/lib/body3.js - swing3, fire3, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js provides viewmodel poses including cast animation.
scripts/lib/ambient.js - fan, fanHousing, cable and DRIP, DUST, MIST, SPORES, BUBBLES, RIPPLE builders/effects; scripts/ambient-anim.js - onSpawn, update.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/lib/level11-shop.js - SHOP, layShop; scripts/level11-elevator.js - updateSchedule, callElevator, ears, update; scripts/l11-masonry.js - geometry, collider; scripts/l11-mall.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/photo2006.js - photoBase, photoFinish.
scripts/lib/level11-quests.js - QUESTS, setSedcoStep, setCraneStep, setMaintStep, finishQuest, handleDialogueQuest; scripts/lib/nav.js - NAV, navBudget, navPath; scripts/l10-worms.js - update, bleed.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, clothing, karma/rep and level access; player inventory APIs receive fishing catch rewards.

scripts/lib/fishing.js - player.state.fishingState session (bobber id, target coordinates, water/place/depth, phase and cast power), canonical water checks, bite/reel outcome and location-based loot selection; scripts/player.js handles session timers and payout.
scripts/bobber.js - spawned bobber's owner/water/phase state and physical float, twitch and plunge behavior; it destroys itself when its owner/session is no longer valid.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; initialize/migrate/spend points, derive carry/combat values and tick companion perks.
scripts/craft.js - craft actions, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; scripts/swim.js owns swimming/underwater/breath and swim session controls, timer and audio.

scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - player focus, loot and sit state; interact.js also assigns nearby containers to NPC owners, persists warn/anger consequences, handles vehicle entry/exit, and tracks the highlighted target.

scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI state and NPC rapport, gifts, trade and rep effects; Level 11 and Level 10 quest libraries write their quest-step keys and shared player.state.quest tracker/payout.

scripts/meg-agent.js - NPC routines, attributes/nerve, loadout, combat, fear, cover, idle social coordination and transient movement/path recovery; scripts/lib/data/chatter.yml supplies Level 10 outpost group conversations.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js behavior order: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3; configured routing invokes scripts/routing.js.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.

world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js; menu actions and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; creator C uses scripts/wardrobe-ui.js to emit dress actions → scripts/critter.js writes player look/outfits.

Spawn room selection → scripts/routing.js pickRoom: accepted ctx.requestedRoomId preserves invited/portal/party rooms; otherwise derives solo-<normalized userId or username> (guest fallback). Engine out-of-bounds → sim.js handles normal player respawn and creature return/destruction.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps paired IDs, writes arrival state.clipKind and calls companion.bring → nearby followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind into state.xfer.kind and scripts/noclip-ui.js renders transition.

places/level10/sim.js → terrain-relative Bumper Crop structures and usable farm props; use events enter scripts/level10-use.js ears.press, which updates player harvest/crafting/resources and quest state.

Level 10 harvest: wheat-patch adds wheat → windmill-quern converts wheat to flour → hearth-oven converts flour to bread; Cooper dialogue in scripts/talk.js invokes handleDialogueQuest10 and NPCs share authored group chatter from chatter.yml.

Level 10 lake and Level 7 sea/Level 11 canal rod casts: scripts/player.js swing path → scripts/lib/fishing.js validates canonical place-specific water, spawns scripts/bobber.js and stores fishingState → scheduled fishNibble/fishBite/fishAutoCatch handlers resolve payout.
Level 10 scarecrow/cellar interaction → level10-use.js records pages/quest steps and grants supplies; quest setters update player.state.quest HUD, notices and payout.
Level 10 sim terrain/field → scripts/l10-worms.js manages worm encounters and scripts/worm10-geo.js renders them; terrain footsteps → scripts/lib/footsteps.js selects field surface clips.
Level 11 sim.js → scripts/lib/level11-city.js lays city/street from level11-models.yml and art models; sim assembles shops and mall via scripts/l11-mall.js and ticks city/chatter behavior.
Place look scripts → scripts/lib/photo2006.js photoBase/photoFinish; level-specific grades feed the common tone, readable shadow lift, bloom and vignette/noise finish.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light state and red-zone variants; Level 5 carries portal/quest props and scripts/l5-rats.js runs Boiler Room Death Rat packs.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office plan, cubicle/phone/printer variants, resident schedules and home claims; Level 7 has its own ocean and room spaces.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies combat and idle social behavior; clothes.yml/mat-cloth.js/critter-model.js vary body and garment appearance.

scripts/lib/craft.js + craft data - recipe category, costs, skill, bench, batch size and item family vary per recipe; fishing_rod is a survival-10 tool craft recipe and also appears in Level 10's lakeside tackle cache.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - room blocks share generated hall/room structure; room type, zone height, lighting, decor and loot vary by authored grid data and deterministic hashes.

places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - food-court venues share service systems with varying menus and Faceling roles; rebuilds queue solids first and remove stale roots incrementally.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/data/level11-models.yml + art/level11 kits and l11-masonry/mall/sedco-shell - generated city/building forms reuse model and architectural kits with seeded district, size and detail variation; mall shell has an open parapet roof, gravel deck and drains.
places/level10/config.yaml + terrain10.js - wheat/barley/stubble/grass terrain decoration layers; scripted crops fade at maxDistance 120 (35 m fade) so distant fields read as stubble ground.
migrationNotes: Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell (120 m square); keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal, sim geometry/hound routing aligned, and roofAt in place state so ceiling checks survive ticks.
Level 2.1 ↔ Level 2, Level 6 ↔ Level 6.1, Level 6.1 ↔ Level 11, and Level 10 ↔ Level 11 paired arrivals are owned by level-door.js; Level 10's lake-deep trigger targets level7#l7-from-l10.

Level 10/184 configs use terrain10.js/terrain184.js heightmap and material queries; keep terrain-relative y placements and arrival/track regions aligned with sim scenery. Level 10's wheat decoration maxDistance is 120 m with 35 m fade over stubble ground.

Fishing casts use world-space positions, place-specific canonical water regions and height constants (Level 7 sea/parlor, Level 10 lake/pond, Level 11 canal); keep fishing.js checks aligned with sim geometry/water surfaces. Bobbers are named to their owner/session.

Level 10 quest state is player.state.wheatQ/watcherQ/cellarQ (step 99 completed), plus wheat/flour/bread resource counts and pages; set*Step synchronizes the single shared player.state.quest HUD slot, so simultaneous quests can replace its active display.

Weapon condition is player.state.cnd_<weapon>; garment condition lives in player.state.look.cnd keyed by garment token and shared across same kind/colour copies; keep clothes.yml pattern IDs implemented by mat-cloth.js. Level 11 mall shell collider remains the plain building body, separate from roof details.
